summary.text: John Henkelman is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 143 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Melissa Simpson.
A scientist who lives in Sanford, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include reducing the cost of living, childcare access, housing and healthcare.

paragraphs.text: Henkelman earned a bachelor's degree from Palm Beach Atlantic University in 2011 and a graduate degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2024, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as scientist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Sanford resident and referred to his work as a Maine Guide.
Henkelman advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

In the survey, he said he would support incentivized local food production and expanded state childcare subsidies and tax credits, and would advocate for increased housing supply in Sanford's city core.
He also said he would advocate for programs such as Land for Maine's Future to protect public access for hunting, fishing and trapping.
